requirements.title: Executive Dashboard
requirements.description: Design and implement an intuitive executive dashboard to display KPIs such as average deal size, revenue, pipeline value, and win rate.
requirements.user_story: As a sales executive, I want to view key performance indicators, so that I can make informed decisions.
assumptions: User has access to the executive dashboard

requirements.title: Leaderboard and Ranking System
requirements.description: Develop a leaderboard that ranks sales reps based on revenue, deals closed, and activities, with the ability to filter and sort data.
requirements.user_story: As a sales manager, I want to view a leaderboard of sales reps, so that I can evaluate their performance.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the sales rep leaderboard section

assumptions: User has access to the sales rep leaderboard section

requirements.title: Customizable Report Interface
requirements.description: Allow users to create custom reports by dragging and dropping fields, applying filters, grouping data, and selecting chart types.
requirements.user_story: As a sales analyst, I want to create custom reports, so that I can analyze sales data.
acceptance_criteria: Allows user to drag and drop fields
Allows user to select chart types

test_steps.action: Navigate to the report builder section

assumptions: User has access to the report builder section

requirements.title: Card Management Features
requirements.description: Implement features such as card freeze/unfreeze, spending limits, and location-based security to enhance user control and security.
requirements.user_story: As a debit card user, I want to have control over my card and its usage, so that I can protect my finances.
acceptance_criteria: Card can be frozen/unfrozen from the app

test_steps.action: Open the app and navigate to the card settings
test_steps.expected_result: The card settings option is available

assumptions: The app is installed and configured correctly

requirements.title: Cashback and Rewards System
requirements.description: Develop a system that offers 1% cashback on all purchases, with rotating bonus categories that offer 3% cashback.
requirements.user_story: As a debit card user, I want to earn cashback rewards on my purchases, so that I can get more value from my debit card.
acceptance_criteria: 1% cashback is earned on all purchases
3% cashback is earned on bonus categories

test_steps.action: Make a purchase using the debit card

test_scenarios: Earning cashback on different types of purchases
assumptions: The app is installed and configured correctly

requirements.title: Real-time Insurance Eligibility Checks
requirements.description: System must perform real-time insurance eligibility checks and display results.
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to verify my insurance eligibility in real-time, so I can book an appointment with confidence.
acceptance_criteria: System connects to payer EDI 270/271 transactions

requirements.title: Display Financial Information
requirements.description: The system displays financial information, including deductibles, before booking an appointment.
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to see my financial obligations, so I can make informed decisions about my appointment.
acceptance_criteria: System displays financial information, including deductibles

requirements.title: Online Payment Options
requirements.description: System allows for various online payment methods, including HSA/FSA cards, bank transfers, and payment plans.
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to pay my bill online, so I can settle my account conveniently.
acceptance_criteria: System allows online payment via HSA/FSA card, bank transfer, and payment plans
Payment is processed securely and accurately

requirements.title: Secondary Insurance Plan Management
requirements.description: System can store and manage secondary insurance plan details for each patient.
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to add multiple insurance plans, so I can ensure accurate billing and coverage.
acceptance_criteria: System allows adding multiple insurance plans
System prioritizes primary and secondary plans correctly

requirements.title: Claim Submission and Tracking
requirements.description: System automates claim submission via EDI 837 format and allows staff to track claim status.
requirements.user_story: As a staff member, I want to submit claims automatically and track their status, so I can manage claims efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: System submits claims automatically via EDI 837 format
Claims are submitted accurately and securely
assumptions: Claim data is valid and complete

requirements.title: Denial Management and Appeal
requirements.description: System provides a workflow for managing denied claims and generating appeal letter templates.
requirements.user_story: As a staff member, I want to manage denied claims and appeal them efficiently, so I can resolve denials effectively.

test_steps.expected_result: Denial is managed and appealed successfully

test_scenarios: Denied claim with valid appeal reason
Denied claim with invalid appeal reason
assumptions: Denied claim data is valid and complete

signature.instructions:
Classify if this is a genuine software requirement of ANY type.

Answer 'yes' if ANY of these are true:
1. User can SEE it on screen or DO/interact with it (functional/UI)
2. It describes a workflow or end-to-end process flow
3. It specifies architecture, API design, or system integration
4. It defines a data model, entity relationship, or schema
5. It sets a performance target, SLA, or scalability requirement
6. It defines security, compliance, or data protection standards

Answer 'no' if it is:
- Technical infrastructure (e.g., 'API Gateway', 'Microservices', 'Database Schema', 'Backend Integration')
- Internal architecture (e.g., 'SaaS multi-tenancy', 'Indexing policy', 'Load Balancing')
- Document noise (executive summary, project objectives, scope statements)
- A UI micro-detail (tooltip text, color hex code, hover animation)
- Vague/generic with no specifics (e.g., 'ensure security', 'optimize performance')

CRITICAL: Prioritize business features (the 'What') over technical implementation (the 'How').
